description: This file is a PHP source code defining a database driver class for Sybase SQL Anywhere, extending an ODBC driver. It provides functions for creating and dropping blob variables, loading blob data from files or variables, and updating blobs in database tables.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADODB_odbc to implement support for Sybase SQL Anywhere database features, including blob handling.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_sqlanywhere
classes.description: A recordset class extending ADORecordSet_odbc for SQL Anywhere results.

methods.name: ADODB_sqlanywhere
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_sqlanywhere class, initializes parent ODBC class.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last auto-increment ID generated.

methods.name: create_blobvar
methods.description: Creates a long binary variable on the database server.

methods.name: drop_blobvar
methods.description: Drops a previously created blob variable.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_file
methods.description: Loads binary data from a file into a blob variable in chunks.

methods.name: load_blobvar_from_var
methods.description: Loads binary data from an in-memory variable into a blob variable in chunks.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column in a table by loading data via a blob variable.
